info.title: Work Tracker API
info.description: Working days, task entries, overtime and PTO.

get.summary: Handles GET requests. Responds with plain text, not JSON.
Every calendar day of a week or date range, recorded or not.

delete.summary: Delete a recorded day and its review flags.

get.summary: One calendar day, recorded or not.
Entries of a week or date range, by date and in the order they were created.

post.summary: Create an entry; a new ticket is created, `service_id` sets the ticket's service.

delete.summary: Delete an entry and its review flags; its history is kept.

get.summary: One entry.

put.summary: Change an entry; only changed fields are written to its history. The kind cannot change.

get.summary: The history of an entry, oldest first; also available after the entry was deleted.

post.summary: Divide a ticket entry among several tickets (e.g. an alias like #4347 aka #1482), hours split evenly.

get.summary: All tickets (sorted by prefix and number) with their service and number of entries.

parameters.name: without_service

schema.description: Only tickets without a service (for review)
schema.title: Without Service

parameters.description: Only tickets without a service (for review)

post.summary: Assign one service to several tickets at once; if a ticket is unknown, nothing changes.

get.summary: A known ticket with the service it remembers (used to pre-fill the service of a new entry).

put.summary: Set or unassign the service of a ticket; it applies to all entries of the ticket.

post.summary: Rename a ticket, or merge it into an existing one (which keeps its service); recorded in each entry's history.

get.summary: Totals of a week (Monday to Sunday) and the overtime balance before and after it.
Totals of a month and the monthly work report: coding work by service and ticket.
Totals of a year, per month, and the PTO account (replaces the spreadsheet dashboard).
Every year with PTO days entered, oldest first.
The PTO days of one year.

put.summary: Enter the PTO days of a year (insert or replace).

get.summary: Everything that needs attention; an item disappears once its reason is fixed or its flag is cleared.

delete.summary: Clear a review flag of an entry or a day (e.g. after checking a guessed ticket key).

get.summary: All records of the list.
One record.
All records of the list.
One record.
